app_concept: Volunteer Connect — Dual-sided NGO and Volunteer coordination platform with LinkedIn-inspired networking, shift scheduling, coverage tracking, and Smart Cancellation Manager ranking replacements.

rules.indic_fallback: Ensure Indic scripts (Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu) render gracefully with system fallbacks ('Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', system-ui).

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand value + dual CTA left, live volunteer network stats & urgent needs cards right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — trust metrics & impact counter left, login form with role switch right
entry_surfaces./register: branded multi-step signup — role selection (NGO vs Volunteer) left panel, registration fields right

layouts.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

cards.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 p-5 sm:p-6
cards.kpi_widget: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-5 flex items-center justify-between

smart_cancellation_manager.candidate_card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-5 hover:border-sky-300 transition-all
smart_cancellation_manager.match_score_ring: Radial progress or prominent score badge displaying weighted match: 40% Skills, 30% Availability, 20% Distance, 10% Interests
smart_cancellation_manager.action_group: Invite Volunteer button with instant confirmation, status pill (Invited / Accepted / Declined / Available)

shift_table.container: rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-sm

map_view.wrapper: rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 h-[420px] shadow-sm relative z-0
map_view.provider: Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles, custom marker icons for emergency vs regular shifts

hero_banner.description: Diverse community volunteers hands joined in center representing unity and nonprofit collaboration
hero_banner.usage: Landing page hero & About page mission section

community_action.description: Volunteer planting saplings during community green drive

volunteer_teamwork.description: Group of enthusiastic youth volunteers engaged in clean city drive

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA (4.5:1 for all normal text, 3:1 for large display)
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY on all action buttons, inputs, tabs, status badges, and filter controls

instructions_to_main_agent: Install leaflet and @types/leaflet (`cd /app/frontend && yarn add leaflet @types/leaflet react-leaflet @types/react-leaflet i18next react-i18next`).
Ensure both NGO and Volunteer dashboards share the exact same clean, professional slate sidebar layout and top navigation for seamless dual-persona switching.
Implement the Smart Cancellation Manager candidate algorithm: display breakdown pills (Skills 40%, Availability 30%, Distance 20%, Interests 10%) with 1-click invitation triggers.
Provide interactive language switcher in header supporting all 5 requested languages with i18n translation keys for core UI terms.
Include high-contrast coverage status badges on event cards: Fully Staffed (Green), Partially Staffed (Amber), Critical Shortage (Red), Fully Booked (Indigo).
Render Recharts analytics on both NGO (Attendance rate, coverage trends, volunteer retention) and Volunteer dashboards (hours contributed, badges earned, impact metrics).
Make sure every interactive button and link includes explicit data-testid attributes like `data-testid='invite-candidate-btn'`, `data-testid='shift-register-btn'`, `data-testid='role-ngo-btn'`.
